purpose: Repeat the unchanged incident-only GSE exit-token audit after fixing only a cold-start circular import.

approval.scope: One replacement audit with the exact V1 data, teacher, thresholds, resource limits and evidence; no V1 partial output reuse.
approval.confirmation_reference: Standing authorization for in-scope implementation repair and continuous execution without repeated approval prompts.

replacement.failure_stage: Python module import before any world or ray
replacement.only_change: Move oriented_edge_polyline import inside ExitRouteGeometryContext.route_target and add a cold-process import regression test.

worlds.train_exact_set: The same sealed 80 C01-C08 parents listed by gse_teacher_manifest_v1 and gse_exit_token_audit_v1.
worlds.validation_exact_set: The same sealed ten C09 parents listed by gse_teacher_manifest_v1 and gse_exit_token_audit_v1.

teacher.candidate_rule: Unchanged from approved V1: node-incident physical edges for junction/terminal; both directions of only the current physical edge otherwise.
teacher.identity: parent:edge:from->to; never collapse different physical edges sharing a tunnel ID.
teacher.geometry: Fixed 2.5 m representative, native-mesh opening width, robot-relative heading and spline z profile at 2.5/5/7.5/10 m.
teacher.visibility: Native-mesh first-return LOS with unchanged 0.25 m endpoint margin; positive infinity is unobstructed, NaN/negative is invalid.
teacher.missing_width: Mask width only; do not substitute radius, delete candidates or change other targets.
teacher.node_failure: Any junction/terminal observation with zero visible incident candidates is formal FAIL.

expected_evidence: 448338 candidate rows and ninety per-world summaries
Zero nonincident candidates and zero node observations without a visible exit
Environment, input/tool hashes, raw log, metrics, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal
failure_policy: Identical to V1. Fail without adapting data, teacher, offset, LOS margin, masks, split or thresholds.
